orgDesign.companyProfile: Technology-enabled freight brokerage, managed transportation, carrier marketplace, TMS, contract logistics, and operations platform.
orgDesign.operatingModel: Shipper teams own planning, procurement, TMS, self-service, and customer integrations. Capacity teams own carrier onboarding, load offers, matching, pricing, and carrier quality. Execution teams own visibility, appointments, documents, control tower, exceptions, and automation. Foundation teams own settlement, risk, financial rules, data, analytics, experimentation, and sustainability.
designPrinciples: Keep shipper service, carrier acceptance, and operations productivity connected because freight reliability is a multi-sided outcome.
Separate capacity marketplace pricing from shipper planning so margin and service tradeoffs remain explicit.
Treat settlement, risk, and data as shared platform capabilities with strict ownership and auditability.
orgDesign.staffingPrinciple: Model total staffing around 250 FTE across delivery teams and group leadership; keep every delivery team at 6-10 FTE, with no individual team above 10 people.
orgDesign.groupingPrinciple: Use top-level groups for shipper control tower, capacity marketplace, execution visibility, and financial/intelligence foundations.
orgDesign.groupLeadershipPrinciple: Every group has explicit lightweight leadership: a Head of group, product and engineering directors, and principal/staff-plus IC coverage for architecture, product quality, and cross-team standards.
